entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-27
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • [dotnet cli]: resolve msbuild properties in launchsettings.json like what Visual Studio IDE #25852
  • .NET 6 NETSDK1152 (found multiple publish output files with the same relative path) triggered by project dependencies defined in .sln file. #23839
  • Flaky: rzc generate exited with code 1 #54894
  • [9.0-preview.7] Microsoft.DotNet.MSBuildWorkloadSdkResolver fails with dotnet workload or build on Windows #42211
  • [dotnet format] CSharpFormattingCodeFixProvider and CSharpRemoveUnnecessaryImportsCodeFixProvider code fixes fail with .NET 9 preview 3 #40174

Updated

  • Flaky test: PostActionTests.AddProjectToSolution_WithOutputRelativePath - .sln file not found #54942
  • ItShouldDetectFileWithMarkOfTheWeb: Expected boolean to be True, but found False #54928
  • Expected collection {empty} to have an item matching (e.Route == "index.html") #54914

  • [Known Build Error] AoT macOS build fails: GetAssemblyAttributes IOException - Microsoft.DotNet.ApiCompat.Task.dll in use by another process #54864
  • NavMenu.razor(1,5): error RZ10007: The attribute 'class' is used two or more times for this element. Attributes must be unique (case-insensitive) #54826

  • Run-file tests failing with "The project file could not be loaded." #54819

  • [Known Build Error] BackCompatibilityPublish_Hosted_Works fails with file lock on .gz compression temp #53660
  • Template Engine SSL Connection Issue #51574
  • Could Not Resolve SDK - repo testfx issue #51530
  • TemplateEngineToolDiscovery Network Failure: Unable to read data from the transport connection: Connection reset by peer #51154
  • Test failing in CI: Microsoft.DotNet.Tests.PackagedCommandTests.CanInvokeToolWhosePackageNameIsDifferentFromDllName : `Tool with output name!` #51146
  • Microsoft.DotNet.Watch.UnitTests.FileWatcherTests.DeleteSubfolder has flaky test assertion #49233
  • Workload Feature Band Test Sometimes Fails #45314
